title: TANGCO: Learning Topology-Aware Capacity Allocation for Overload-driven Cascading Failures
abstract: arXiv:2608.13212v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Networked systems, from power grids to traffic networks and cloud clusters, carry loads across nodes with limited capacity. A node whose load exceeds its capacity fails and sheds its load onto its neighbors, which can trigger a system-wide cascade. We study how to allocate a fixed capacity budget across nodes to resist these cascades under local load redistribution. The problem is difficult because no optimal allocation is known, and the fail-or-survive objective is non-differentiable and piecewise constant, so exact and gradient-based optimization methods do not directly apply. We introduce TANGCO (Topology-Aware Neural Graph-Guided Capacity Optimization), which uses a graph neural network policy trained through the cascade simulator with policy-gradient learning and a heuristic anchor. translated_title: TANGCO：面向过载驱动级联故障的拓扑感知容量分配学习
translated_abstract: 网络系统，从电网到交通网络和云集群，在容量有限的节点间承载负载。负载超过其容量的节点会失效并将其负载转移到邻居节点，这可能触发系统范围的级联故障。我们研究如何在局部负载重分配下，将固定容量预算分配给各个节点以抵抗这些级联故障。该问题具有挑战性，因为目前没有已知的最优分配方案，且“失败或存活”的目标函数不可微且分段常数，因此精确优化和基于梯度的优化方法无法直接应用。我们提出了TANGCO（拓扑感知神经图引导容量优化），该方法使用图神经网络策略，通过级联模拟器结合策略梯度学习和启发式锚点进行训练。我们在五个合成图族和五个涵盖电力、道路、航空和互联网拓扑的真实网络上评估了TANGCO。学习到的策略改进了……
tldr: 本文提出TANGCO，一种基于图神经网络和策略梯度学习的容量分配方法，用于在过载驱动的级联故障中优化固定容量预算的分配，以增强网络鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TANGCO, a graph neural network-based capacity allocation method with policy-gradient learning, to optimize fixed capacity budgets against overload-driven cascading failures and enhance network robustness.
